notes.title: Patch v1.7 delivers full Steam Deck compatibility!
notes.content:
Patch 1.7 Highlights:

Steam Deck Compatibility & Enhancements:

-Full Steam Deck Support: Higher Than Mush is now fully compatible with the Steam Deck!
-Play Anywhere: Enjoy the complete Higher Than Mush on the go.
-SteamOS Performance Optimization: We've specifically optimized the game for improved performance and stability on SteamOS.

General Gameplay Improvements & Fixes:

-UI Fix (Leaderboard): Resolved a UI bug that affected the leaderboard display, ensuring better clarity.
-New Player Experience: Adjusted the difficulty at the beginning for a smoother onboarding experience for all players.

notes.title: Patch v1.6
notes.content:
Patch Version 1.6

Features:
-Added display of player attempt counts to the leaderboard for new scores.

Fixes:
-Game now pauses correctly when the window loses focus.
-Fixed a UI bug on the leaderboard screen.

Upcoming:
-Dedicated Steam Deck compatibility improvements are planned for Patch 1.7.
